title: Not the best but will do if you want something simple
body: It’s a good app, and I have bought and used the  pro version to be able to do stuff with friends. Very simplistic in design, but quite good with alternatives of goals (counter, fluids, time,etc). Usually around upgrades there are some issues. Also cloud doesn’t always work and you have to double check some time later whether an activity really saved the progress. Hence sometimes, the overall counter is also a bit weird. All in all, though, I’m leaving it. I have been using it for 9 months, there are features that are not available (organising goals/sub-tasks/calendar integration) that I would want to use. And honestly, the design of the goal list is a bit overwhelming which for me beats the entire purpose.
